title: Chicken and Chorizo Chili
description: Chicken and chorizo sausage are simmered with bell pepper, two types of beans, spices, fire-roasted tomatoes, and beer for a comforting chili recipe.
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer
1 (28 ounce) can fire-roasted diced tomatoes, with juice

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven or large pot over medium-high heat. Add chorizo; cook and stir until heated through, about 2 minutes. Transfer chorizo to a bowl using a slotted spoon.

Add chicken to the Dutch oven; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 6 minutes. Season with chili powder and cumin. Stir in chorizo, black beans, white beans, onion, bell pepper, and garlic; cook and stir until onion begins to soften, 5 to 6 minutes.

Add beer to the Dutch oven; bring to a simmer. Add tomatoes, chicken stock, and tomato paste; simmer until heated through, about 5 minutes. Season with salt. Reduce heat to low; simmer until flavors blend, about 30 minutes.
